changelog:
- Clarified triggers and exclusions for when to perform reviews (explicit code/diff/test/health requests only).
- Outlined strict usage of the Iron Law reporting pattern (Symptom → Source → Consequence → Remedy).
- Added mode-based loading guidance for efficiency (Quick, PR Review, Architecture, Tests, Release).
- Provided detailed risk index tables for production, tests, and editorial checks.
- Expanded session contract to enforce default review-only behavior and scope discipline.
- Updated companion file roles and references for easier navigation.
- Refined severity and scoring framework, emphasizing use of canonical references for scoring mechanics.
summary: Pair-style code quality reviewer: twelve book-grounded decay risks (R1–R6, T1–T6) plus release-safety and first-paint UX checks. Findings always use Iron Law (Symptom → Source → Consequence → Remedy) and a 0–100 review-index Health Score. Triggers when: user asks to review code/PR/diff, "any issues"
